Swoszowice (dzielnica 10) — Kraków, Poland

In detail

Grouped with Podgórze Duchackie and Bieżanów-Prokocim in the 2024 police district breakdown (232 property thefts, 18 vehicle thefts, 23 burglaries, 7 robberies, 20 bodily injuries, 3 fights across the three combined — a moderate, mid-table result). The 2020 Otodom survey placed the broader Dębniki/Łagiewniki/Borek Fałęcki/Swoszowice evening-safety group at 3.99/5, a solidly positive score. No incident coverage specific to this individual district was found beyond these grouped figures. Sources checked: Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
